paragraphs: In [Gittin 56a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.56a.6-7) it is told that the Romans sent him to destroy Jerusalem, and when he came to the Land of Israel he found a child and said to him: Recite to me your verse. The child said to him: "[And I will lay My vengeance upon Edom by the hand of My people Israel.](https://www.sefaria.org/Ezekiel.25.14)" Nero said, “Does the Holy One, blessed be He, intend to destroy His house and hold me responsible?” He fled, went, and converted, and Rabbi Meir descended from him.[^1]

notes.text: The Aramaic literally says “wipe His hands on that man.” Nero is referring to himself. His conversion and Rabbi Meir’s descent from him are statements within the linked Talmudic account.
